# Linkloom

> India's influencer marketing marketplace. Brands post a brief, creators bid in minutes, and escrow holds the payment until the work is approved.

Linkloom is a two-sided marketplace that connects brands with Indian content creators across Instagram and YouTube. The platform uses an escrow-based payment model so brands only pay once they approve the deliverable, and creators start work knowing the money is committed.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://linkloom.in/): Landing page with how-it-works, platform demos, and escrow explainer
- [Help & FAQ](https://linkloom.in/help.html): Questions for creators, brands, escrow, and account management
- [Privacy Policy](https://linkloom.in/privacy.html): DPDP Act 2023 compliant privacy policy
- [Terms of Use](https://linkloom.in/terms.html): Terms governing the marketplace
- [Refunds & Escrow](https://linkloom.in/refunds.html): Escrow and refund policy with timelines
- [Cookie Policy](https://linkloom.in/cookies.html): Cookie policy and consent settings

## What Linkloom does

- Creators browse brand briefs and submit bids with a proposed price
- Brands review bids, accept one, and pay the agreed amount into escrow
- The creator delivers the content; the brand approves it
- Escrow releases payment to the creator on approval
- Supported platforms: Instagram (Reels, Posts, Stories), YouTube (Videos, Shorts)
- Target market: India

The creator dashboard (/app.html) and brand dashboard (/brand.html) require a signed-in account and are excluded from search indexing.
